description: This is a PHP source file defining the Analytics controller within the Opencart admin extension system. It manages listing, installation, and uninstallation of analytics extensions, including handling permissions, dynamic loading of extensions, and rendering views.

classes.name: Analytics
classes.description: Controller class for managing analytics extensions in the Opencart admin panel, providing methods for listing, installing, and uninstalling analytics modules.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Entry point that outputs the list of analytics extensions.

methods.name: getList
methods.description: Retrieves and prepares data for the analytics extensions list view, including available and installed extensions, and handles their display.

methods.name: install
methods.description: Handles the installation of a specified analytics extension, including permission checks, autoloading, and registering the extension.

methods.name: uninstall
methods.description: Handles the uninstallation of a specified analytics extension, including permission checks and cleanup.
